# Roblox test-file fixtures

`baseplate-413.rbxlx` is an unmodified copy of Roblox's test corpus file
[`places/baseplate-413/xml.rbxlx`](https://github.com/Roblox/rbx-test-files/blob/master/places/baseplate-413/xml.rbxlx)
(Git blob `299e730ae7aff9533f7b8f6a19ba006fc73aa6c6`).

`object-prototypes.rbxmx` contains the empty Folder, SpawnLocation, Script,
LocalScript, and ModuleScript objects extracted from Roblox's
[`places/all-instances-415/xml.rbxlx`](https://github.com/Roblox/rbx-test-files/blob/master/places/all-instances-415/xml.rbxlx)
(Git blob `a55687362ca706a24a7c4fc419cf8917a1d4eb74`). No scripts from that
corpus are included.

The fixtures and place file generated from them are derived from the Roblox
test corpus, available under the included [MIT license](LICENSE.txt).
They are format examples from an older Roblox version; the generated place
still needs to be opened and tested in the user's current Roblox Studio.
